Theorem
[Heat kernel expansion for evolving metrics] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0299, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0300 ↗ thm:chow-iii-closed-evolving-heat-kernel ↗ lem:chow-iii-parametrix-convolution-derivatives 1. ch24:24.21\group Heat Kernel Asymptotics

On a closed manifold there are smooth $u_k$, agreeing locally with $\psi _k$, such that \[ H=(4\pi (\tau -v))^{-n/2}e^{-d_\tau ^2/(4(\tau -v))} \sum _{k=0}^N(\tau -v)^ku_k+w_N, \] where, uniformly in $x,y$, \[ |\partial _\tau ^\ell \nabla _x^kw_N| =O\bigl((\tau -v)^{N+1-n/2-k-2\ell }\bigr). \]
